source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Γρηγόριος Αρχιεπίσκοπος Ροστώβ, Γιαροσλάβλ και Λευκής Λίμνης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and the body is one sentence and a half: born in Russia in the fourteenth century, abbot of the monastery of the Transfiguration of the Saviour on the island of Kamenny in lake Kubenskoe near the country of Vologda, elected archbishop of the city of Rostov, dead 1416. **`office` keeps only Rostov**, which is what the body gives; the listing's fuller style, Ροστώβ, Γιαροσλάβλ και Λευκής Λίμνης — Rostov, Yaroslavl and the White Lake — is the see's later three-part title and is recorded here rather than put in the folder, because the body names the election to Rostov alone. The see and the year tell him from the corpus's thirty-odd other Gregories, of whom only `gregory-of-novgorod` and `gregory-of-pelshma` are Russian and neither is of Rostov. Its `NEARSLUG` neighbour `gregory-of-argos` is a fifteenth-century Greek hierarch of a Peloponnesian see and a different man. No hymn, no relic.
